mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_active, is_deleted FROM public."user" WHERE username = #{username} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT user_id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_active, is_deleted FROM public."user" WHERE email = #{email} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public."user" WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public."user" u WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.is_deleted = 0
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."user" WHERE user_id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."user" ( username, email, password, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_active, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{address}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{isActive}, 0 ) RETURNING user_id
